stories.story_fr: NatWest Markets Group (NWM Group) a enregistré une perte de 20 m£ au troisième trimestre 2019.
stories.story_en: NatWest Markets Group (NWM Group) reported a loss of £20 million for Q3 2019.
stories.quote: NatWest Markets Group (NWM Group) reported a loss of £20 million for Q3 2019

stories.story_fr: Le revenu était de 106 m£ au T3 2019, contre 230 m£ au T2 2019.
stories.story_en: Income was £106 million in Q3 2019, compared with £230 million in Q2 2019.
stories.quote: Income was £106 million in Q3 2019, compared with £230 million in Q2 2019

stories.story_fr: Les actifs et passifs totaux ont augmenté de 65,8 milliards et 66,4 milliards de livres respectivement, atteignant 313,7 milliards et 305,2 milliards.
stories.story_en: Total assets and liabilities increased by £65.8 billion and £66.4 billion to £313.7 billion and £305.2 billion respectively.
stories.quote: Total assets and liabilities increased by £65.8 billion and £66.4 billion to £313.7 billion and £305.2 billion respectively

stories.story_fr: Le revenu de base de NatWest Markets s'est établi à 1 082 m£, soit 177 m£, ou 14,1 %, de moins qu'en 2018.
stories.story_en: NatWest Markets core income of £1,082 million was £177 million, or 14.1%, lower than 2018.
stories.quote: NatWest Markets core income of £1,082 million was £177 million, or 14.1%, lower than 2018

stories.story_fr: RBS a déclaré un bénéfice d'exploitation avant impôt de 4 232 m£.
stories.story_en: RBS reported an operating profit before tax of £4,232 million.
stories.quote: RBS reported an operating profit before tax of £4,232 million
